mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 4% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a term premium compression effect, lowering discount rates and pushing up near-term equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the month prior to prediction
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day rolling mean of the same period, or term premium spread (SP500 futures - 10y Treasury) does not widen materially.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 250 for three consecutive months indicate deflationary pressure, reducing real discount rates and supporting equity valuations, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns underperform the 12-month rolling average, or CPIAUCSL re-enters inflationary (> 3%) territory within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 4%) signals a strong labor market, prompting optimism about corporate earnings and equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 10% in a month while UNRATE falls below 4%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of similar labor market events, or the correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE and SPX 20d returns falls below 0.35.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales (HOUST) exceeding 5% month-over-month, occurring during a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO), suggests improving consumer demand while weak manufacturing signals a rotation into consumer cyclicals, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM while INDPRO falls > 2% MoM
regime_hint: Demand-side rotation from industrial to consumer cyclicals
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 3 out of 10 such rotation events, or the cross-correlation between HOUST and SPX 5d returns turns negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 for two consecutive months, despite stable or rising employment, indicates supply-side constraints that raise uncertainty and compress discount rates, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Supply shock or weak demand-supply balance
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the 30-day rolling mean during such INDPRO contractions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals a cooling labor market, raising policy uncertainty and compressing discount rates, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns outperform the 12-month rolling average during such unemployment spikes.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of negative real yields (implied by low-term rates and high inflation expectations) persists for 4 consecutive months, signaling a risk-on environment where investors prefer equities, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS < 1.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant vs. a neutral benchmark (zero mean) during such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp and persistent drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 for three consecutive months, coupled with no meaningful improvement in retail sales (HOUST), indicates deepening supply-side bottlenecks that raise recession risk and compress discount rates, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 90 for three consecutive months and HOUST < 105 for the same period
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of analogous INDPRO/HOUST weakness events.
